claude.performance_metric: No divestiture; acquired product retained in Salix segment (revenue +1% to $2,090M, profit -$4M to $1,489M in FY2022)
claude.rationale: The slice documents that the acquired product (Trulance) was retained inside the acquirer's Salix operating segment and was cited as a positive contributor to product-sales movement, with no documented product/process incoherence — the product aligned with segment operations rather than breaking against them (p4=0). No documented operations-versus-organization/people/culture fracture appears anywhere in the realized record; the only frictions noted are generic-entry litigation and small revenue share, which are market/competitive facts, not process/organization fractures (p5=0). No evidence of controlling-intent archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility is documented in the window.
